entities.name: Amazon Macie
entities.rationale: Central Macie service inside the main AWS Account that coordinates sensitive data scans and outputs findings.

entities.name: Amazon S3
entities.rationale: Central S3 bucket in the main AWS Account holding scan findings metadata.

entities.name: Amazon Athena
entities.rationale: Serverless query service in the main AWS Account querying findings stored in Amazon S3.

entities.name: Amazon QuickSight
entities.rationale: Business intelligence service in the main AWS Account visualizing sensitive data risks and dashboards.

entities.name: MySQL
entities.rationale: Database / data lake repository in the main AWS Account storing aggregated findings and bucket ownership information.

entities.name: AWS Glue
entities.rationale: ETL and automation service in the main AWS Account used to process, aggregate, and load findings data.

entities.name: Security Engineers
entities.rationale: Internal security engineering team monitoring data security posture and driving remediation.

entities.name: Amazon Macie (Member Account 1)
entities.rationale: Macie instance deployed in the top-right member production AWS Account.

entities.name: Amazon S3 (Member Account 1)
entities.rationale: Target S3 bucket scanned for sensitive data in the top-right member production AWS Account.

entities.name: Amazon Macie (Member Account 2)
entities.rationale: Macie instance deployed in the bottom-right member production AWS Account.

entities.name: Amazon S3 (Member Account 2)
entities.rationale: Target S3 bucket scanned for sensitive data in the bottom-right member production AWS Account.

visual_connections.description: Curved yellow arrow drawn from central Macie to the central S3 bucket representing the delivery of metadata and findings.
Yellow arrow drawn from Amazon Athena pointing to the central S3 bucket representing discovery queries.
Yellow arrow drawn from QuickSight pointing towards the central findings bucket to query reporting data.
Yellow arrow drawn pointing down to MySQL indicating findings data is ingested into the MySQL data lake.
